reason: The synchronous context shim cannot carry implicit config across the routed model's asynchronous policy and credential acquisition. model.invoke without explicit config therefore receives no stream callbacks on this /web lane. Missing messages remove their positions from modes and shift first-appearance UUID numbers for checkpoint parents. Re-measured after context installation; all other transcript fields match native Node.
